def generate_inputs(device):
    x = torch.ones((16, 256, 256), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    # Set column 16 and 17 to different values
    # Thread 16 will have product involving column 16's values
    # Thread 17 will have product involving column 17's values
    # Original shuffles lane 0 with lane 16, mutant with lane 17
    x[:, :, 16] = 10.0  # Makes thread 16's product = 10^256 is too large
    # Use a single element modification instead to avoid overflow
    x = torch.ones((16, 256, 256), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    x[:, 0, 16] = 100.0   # Thread 16's product = 100.0 * 1^255 = 100.0
    x[:, 0, 17] = 0.01    # Thread 17's product = 0.01 * 1^255 = 0.01
    return [x]

    x = torch.ones((16, 256, 256), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
    # Set column 16 to a large value in one reduction row
